project_view_only.why: The caller is a viewer of this project (project-viewer-role 01, owner decision VIEWER-ROLE-1): every write, undo, snapshot restore and non-read tool is refused, over HTTP (services/project_write_gate.py) and in chat (harness/restrictions.require_allowed), whatever personal rule is saved. Nothing is written; the model says the project is view-only and that the project owner can grant edit access, and offers read-only help instead.
